description.value: Terradise Eco-Tours is an Indigenous-owned eco-tourism guiding company in Terrace, BC, led by Mandi McDougall, an entrepreneur of Gitxsan descent and proud member of Indigenous Tourism BC. The company offers personalized day trips in the Coast Mountains of the Skeena region, including hiking, fossil hunting, remote jet boat tours, ice fishing, and glacier helicopter adventures. A touring cyclist passing through the Terrace area could book a guided day trip to experience the backcountry with deep local and cultural knowledge.
